notFound: Amazon Basics: amazon.com search pages and WebFetch were blocked (503/robot page); product pages were read one ASIN at a time with curl, so only models surfaced by eight searches are listed. Sets (2/3/4-piece) excluded as not single models. Amazon.ca, amazon.co.uk and amazon.com.mx listings were not read, so no CA/UK/IE/MX offers. The 150 L foldable duffel (B01GGNW67O) is now sold as 'Amazon Essentials (Previously Amazon Basics)' and was left out. Several colour ASINs of the same model show different capacity figures on Amazon (e.g. 21-inch hardside 32/34/39 L); the Black listing's figures were used.

Ricardo Beverly Hills: only the US store (ricardobeverlyhills.com) exists; no Canada, Mexico, UK or Ireland storefront found. 'Member Exclusive' duplicates, sets, totes, the cooler and packing accessories excluded. Outside dimensions not published on the pages for Claremont 2.0, Oceano, Rodeo Drive 2.0 hardside, Flight Essentials and the Melrose 19-inch; the Montecito 2.0 rolling garment bag's spec block was malformed, so its size and weight are null.

Kenneth Cole Reaction: kennethcole.com (luggage made by licensee Olivet) is the only maker storefront found; US only. Macy's and Nordstrom Rack listings were not read (bot-protected). Warranty is stated as 'lifetime limited' on several suitcases, which has no year figure, so warrantyYears is null. Sets, totes, messenger bags, belt bags and bundles excluded; laptop/computer backpacks are included as backpacks.

London Fog: no maker storefront found. thelondonfogluggage.com, londonfogluggagestore.com and similar sites look unofficial and were not used. Luggage Factory's London Fog feed (luggagefactory.com) lists ~250 items, many of them older collections with placeholder $396 prices, so it was not used as evidence of current sale. Boscov's product pages (via its sitemap) were used instead; every listing there carries a sale price and some are closeouts. Macy's and Kohl's listings (Cambridge, Brentwood III closeout, Oakwood, Southbridge, Queensbury) were not read (bot-protected). Most Boscov's pages publish no dimensions.

Traveler's Choice: travelerchoice.com read in full; sold-out models (Silverwood, Mykel, Ruma II Medium, On the Go II, Froster duffel) excluded, and the Jericho Large is listed under a 'pre-order' handle, so it was excluded as not yet released. US only; no CA/MX/UK store found.

Roots: roots.com sells only bags (leather Banff duffels, a nylon weekender, backpacks); its US pages returned the same figures as its Canadian pages, so only the CAD price is recorded. Roots-licensed hard luggage (Chalet, Identity, Travel collections) is not on roots.com; it was read from Canada Luggage Depot and the CAA Manitoba store (secondhand). Leather day packs, slings and the Mini Banff bag excluded as not luggage.

Totto: read from mx.totto.com (VTEX catalogue API, category Viaje). Hiking packs (Summit), accessories and fanny packs excluded. Totto has no US, Canada, UK or Ireland store found; the Mexican offer is the only one. Prices recorded are the list prices on the site on the day read.

Chenson: chenson.com.mx (1,769 items, mostly school backpacks, lunch bags and handbags) carries only one luggage model in stock, the Chenson Pro EROS cabin case (grey, black and green). The Chenson Pro STARK 2-piece kit (MXN 4,999) is a set and its larger piece isn't sold alone, so it was not listed. Coppel and Liverpool listings were not read. Weight and capacity are not published.

Coolife: coolifeluggage.com read in full; 3-, 4- and 5-piece sets excluded. Amazon listings of Coolife luggage (its main channel) were not read. US only. Shell weight in the store's data (13.6 kg on every product) is a shipping placeholder and was not used.

Wrangler: wrangler.com luggage pages return 403 (Cloudflare) to both WebFetch and curl, including the 22.5-inch spinner TCLUG; luggagebywrangler.com and wranglerluggage.com look unofficial and were not used. The licensee store travelersclub.com was read; sold-out items (Morgan, 20-inch hardside and softside, 30-inch duffel, 36-inch locker duffel) and sets (Astral, El Dorado, Charlotte, 2- and 4-piece) excluded. Walmart and Amazon listings were not read. Wrangler outside dimensions are published only for the Slimfold line.
UK and Ireland: none of these ten brands was found with a UK or Irish luggage storefront that could be read; Amazon Basics luggage is sold on amazon.co.uk but was not read.
